title: How to Set Up Blink Cloud in Cursor: 2-Minute Guide
summary: How to set up Blink Cloud in Cursor: run one command, log in, and your agent gains database, auth, hosting, and 80+ MCP tools. No mcp.json editing required.
body_markdown: Skills are high-level task workflows — "set up user auth," "provision a Postgres database," "deploy a backend to Blink." MCP tools are the lower-level primitives those skills use: create a table, run a migration, add an environment variable, check deployment status. You interact with skills by describing what you want to build. The agent uses MCP tools to carry out each step.
